artifact: Verification bundle: its items, its frontier and the payload of its manifest; the manifest is a COSE_Sign1 of the profile in crates/permguard-objects/src/cose.rs by a host.operations key, content type permguard.keys.bundle.v1, its kid that key's <ring>:<thumbprint>, the key active at the frontier; the bundle digest is SHA-256 of "permguard.keys.bundle.v1\n" and every item's SHA-256 in ascending order
authority: 1-architecture/4-architecture-server-host-keys.md#library-and-api, 6-contracts/8-contract-host-api.md (GET /host/v1/keys/bundle), owner decisions of 2026-10-09 (peer projection, encoding, signer, frontier, bindings per epoch, resource, anchor); crates/permguard-host/src/keys/bundle.rs
encoding: deterministic CBOR (RFC 8949 core deterministic), integers in the signed 64-bit range

fields.name: document
fields.note: the identity document's COSE_Sign1 of the frontier's identity epoch (identity.json)

fields.name: successions
fields.note: every succession record's COSE_Sign1, oldest first; at most 1024

fields.name: first_public_key
fields.note: the epoch-1 public key the chain is walked from, the one the pinned fingerprint names

fields.name: kid
fields.note: <ring>:<thumbprint>

fields.name: jwk
fields.note: the RFC 7517 JSON of the public key as published

fields.name: epoch
fields.note: the ring epoch its prepublication opened

fields.name: state
fields.note: its state at the frontier: prepublished, active, retired-public, revoked or archived

fields.name: envelope
fields.note: a ring binding (keys.json ring_binding), its COSE_Sign1 by the identity key of the epoch its kid names; one per `bound` journal entry up to the frontier

fields.name: epoch
fields.note: the ring epoch once the revocation applied

fields.name: at
fields.note: seconds since the epoch, UTC

fields.name: identity_epoch
fields.note: from 1

fields.name: rings
fields.note: sorted by ring, each once; host.identity never, its chain stands for it

fields.name: peers
fields.note: the memberships this Host coordinates whose member the bundle carries, fixed at the membership journal's entry `seq`: their count and the SHA-256 of the `peers` item listing them; absent when none

fields.name: host_id
fields.note: exactly 16 bytes

fields.name: resource
fields.note: the canonical resource text of the Host API grammar

fields.name: items
fields.note: how many items the bundle holds

fields.name: bundle_digest
fields.note: 32 bytes

fields.name: issued_at
fields.note: when the first page fixed the frontier, seconds since the epoch, UTC

fields.name: manifest
fields.note: the membership manifest of the frontier's epoch, COSE_Sign1 by a host.operations key of this Host (membership.json manifest)

fields.name: presentation
fields.note: the member's identity as its enrollment session proved it (session.json presentation); its first fingerprint the one the manifest pins

fields.name: statements
fields.note: the member's ring statements its manifest pins, one per pinned ring

fields.name: coordinator
fields.note: this Host's statements of the rings the manifest pins, as it signed it: its `host.operations` set, bound by its identity, digesting to the pin's set, holding the manifest's signer; 1 to 16

fields.name: binding
fields.note: membership.json ring_statement

fields.name: entries
fields.note: sorted by membership, each once, 1 to 8192

ring_frontier.name: seq
ring_frontier.note: the ring's last journal entry at the frontier, from 1

peer_frontier.name: manifest_digest
peer_frontier.note: 32 bytes: SHA-256 of `permguard.membership.manifest.v1\n` and the manifest envelope

peer_set.name: seq
peer_set.note: the membership journal's last entry when the frontier was fixed, from 1

peer_set.name: digest
peer_set.note: 32 bytes: SHA-256 of the `peers` item's bytes
